# ratgdo v32 Garage Door

Read and operate an installed ratgdo v32 garage-door controller's door, light and lock entities through Muse Home Link, via its enabled HTTP or native ESPHome API. Movement requires an explicit, authorized requested action, the intended door confirmed and movement safe, with all opener interlocks and obstruction protections preserved. This device-specific skill is preferred over the generic gadget-esphome-devices skill for ratgdo controllers.
